_about: A rarely taken skill carried by a gun (the owner, 2026-11-06; docs/notes/weapon-skill-bonuses.md): modification 2120, hip-fire spread -10 % (skill 106's five ranks), on the gun's own dispersion/from_the_hip_multiplier (type 2: the cook multiplies it by 0.9), since a weapon registers no player modifier. Its card line is property 101 (Dispersion off the hip), as the gear's 1070..1074 show theirs. A type of its own (42, never rolled: drop weight 0). weapon-stats.tsv makes it the SV-1367 Dusk's built-in (column hip_bonus), modifications.tsv holds its row.
